comment: One fixture for both twins of the rule 'only the version of a golang image line changed': scripts/ci/pr_classify.py (golang_image_bump_only) and tests/conformance/registry/lockcode.go (GolangImageBumpOnly). kind=compose is read by both; kind=dockerfile and kind=dockerfile-pin by the Python side only (the Go twin has no Dockerfile reader: its only consumer is the compose lock-runtime-config rule). kind=dockerfile is the toolchain rule (golang_image_bump_only), kind=dockerfile-pin is the digest-pin rule (image_pin_only). A golang line may carry an optional @sha256:<64 lowercase hex> digest on either side and the two may differ; any other digest, or a digest without a tag, is never verified. The CR, Unicode-digit and Unicode-space cases are smuggles found by an independent review.
